in_hebrew.name: Glennon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Glennon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Gaelic word glen, meaning 'valley' or 'glen', and don, meaning 'valley of the little river'.

in_greek.name: Glennon
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει River valley
in_greek.long_meaning: Glennon είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Gaelic word glen, meaning 'valley' or 'glen', and don, meaning 'valley of the little river'.

in_latin.name: Glennon
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat River valley
in_latin.long_meaning: Glennon est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Gaelic word glen, meaning 'valley' or 'glen', and don, meaning 'valley of the little river'.
